parameters.query:
select id, name, bank, type, closing_day, due_day, last_four_digits
from public.accounts
where (owner_id = $1::uuid or user_id = $2::uuid)
  and (nullif($3, '') is null or unaccent(bank) ilike '%' || unaccent($3) || '%' or unaccent(name) ilike '%' || unaccent($3) || '%')
order by type, bank;

select id, name, bank, type, closing_day, due_day, last_four_digits
from public.accounts
where (owner_id = $1::uuid or user_id = $2::uuid)
  and (nullif($3, '') is null or unaccent(bank) ilike '%' || unaccent($3) || '%' or unaccent(name) ilike '%' || unaccent($3) || '%')
order by type, bank;

activeVersion.name: Corrige match de banco com acento (unaccent)
activeVersion.description: Mesma correcao do 1.06/1.08: ILIKE nao ignora acento no Postgres. "Itaú" (com acento) nao batia com bank='itau', fazendo buscar_cartoes_banco retornar vazio quando o cliente pedia contas de um banco com acento no nome.
